Container.Name: mastarr
Container.Overview: Mastarr brings movies, series, downloads and release calendars into one private control room. Connect Sonarr, Radarr and SABnzbd once; configuration and encrypted API keys remain on the server. Other devices only sign in. On first run open the container console and read /config/setup-token to claim your administrator account. Use a trusted LAN or VPN, or an HTTPS reverse proxy with PUBLIC_ORIGIN and SECURE_COOKIES configured. Requires existing media engines; does not replace their indexers or import services. The versioned image is available after its release workflow has been published.
